name: Team Iowa Promotional Products and Apparel
old_description: Looking for a specific item or just browsing for ideas? Team Iowa is your one-stop shop for promotional products and business gifts. Our extensive range of promo products will ensure you find something to suit your requirements. With 1000s of selections, Team Iowa offers branded merchandise to fulfill all of your needs. Put our knowledge about promotional products to work for you. With high quality promotional products, fast delivery times, and prices to fit all budgets, we will provide customized, relevant recommendations for you. Simply take a look around or contact us now and we'll do the shopping for you!
about:
Team Iowa Promotional Products and Apparel is based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. The company operates as a promotional products distributor and decorator, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm sources thousands of promotional items—from apparel to hard goods—and provides in-house decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, and other imprint methods. It also offers fulfillment services, creative support, and builds customized online company stores for clients to manage branded merchandise programs. The company describes its offering as end-to-end service, handling everything from product selection to warehousing and distribution.

Team Iowa serves businesses of all sizes, including large organizations with multiple locations or departments that need secure internal stores for employees or public-facing stores for fans, customers, and partners. Its client base spans any industry requiring branded merchandise for marketing, recognition, or safety programs.

The company emphasizes its product knowledge and ability to deliver customized recommendations with fast turnaround times and budget-friendly pricing. It also hosts an annual industry event, TIPPS, and provides an online Idea Generator tool to help clients quickly identify suitable promotional products.
